correctness.rationale: For n≥2 choose c=[x1,x2]∈F_n, and u_j=c^j for 1≤j≤m. Under the cited Makri Proposition 5.1 arbitrary finite Reidemeister coordinate lists are simultaneously realizable for a single homeomorphism with trivial loop braid. Abelianization kills all commutator powers, giving linking vector zero. Theorem 4.6 identifies Nielsen classes at loop braid 1 with ordinary conjugacy. Each c^j is cyclically reduced without cross-copy cancellation and has cyclically reduced length 4j, a conjugacy invariant; hence all constructed fixed points are in distinct Nielsen classes. This is an exact all-finite-m argument conditional on the published proposition as quoted in the frozen package, not extrapolation from m=2.
